title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Tier Credited on a Payer Conversion
content:
**Tier pricing note, conversions — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The conversion credit tier — the tier whose daily rate the conversion credit gives back — follows the room the charge was billed for.

1. Where the agreement's tier is not the tier the charge was posted for and the agreement carries no isolation placement: the tier the charge was posted for.
2. Where the agreement carries an isolation placement: the isolation billing tier of the agreement's tier.
3. Otherwise: the agreement's own tier.

| Agreement's tier | Its isolation billing tier |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |

**Points of judgement.** A charge posted for the room the resident has since left, no isolation placement: rule 1. Any charge on an agreement with an isolation placement: rule 2, whatever tier the charge shows.
